object.attr: derived: CF-V13 (D-V8), which merges the draft's tag-only guard. The user tags the state that the dialog's warnings were found for; a commit or checkout in between would be tagged unseen. MELLON-VER-SRS-124 covers a commit.
object.description: If the latest commit or the current branch changed after the commit dialog opened, Mellon shall refuse to tag without a new commit and say what changed.
